Antoi Branch 2
Aug 2026 • Couples
I was worried that everyone would line up at the original An Toi branch when I went to Nha Trang, but I heard there was a second branch, so I went right away!
To get straight to the point, if you want to reduce waiting stress and eat much more comfortably, the second branch is the answer.
As soon as I walked in, the air conditioning felt very cool, and the store was spacious and clean, so my mood instantly lifted when I walked in when I was tired from the heat. The interior is beautifully decorated with a yellow local feel and rattan lamps, so the photos come out well.
